description:
Varlock is an open source tool that changes how developers manage environment variables by eliminating the need to store plain text secrets on disk. Using a type-safe schema system, Varlock resolves environment variables locally or from secure secrets managers like 1Password, Bitwarden, and AWS, then injects them into your application at runtime. This means your .env files become safe to commit publicly and share with AI agents, while maintaining bulletproof security through features like automatic type generation, log redaction, and seamless CI/CD integration - making it the ultimate solution for developers tired of the constant struggle with secret management and environment variable chaos.
